title: Metroidvania Biome Environment Concept
summary: A side-view environment concept for a metroidvania biome with traversal readability built in: clear walkable surfaces, a gated path that needs a later ability, layered parallax depth and a focal landmark. Slots for biome, gating ability, landmark and palette.
prompt:
A side-view environment concept painting for one biome of a 2D metroidvania, drawn the way the player will see it in game, at gameplay camera scale.

Biome: {argument name="biome" default="a sunken cathedral reclaimed by bioluminescent fungus, half flooded, with collapsed organ pipes"}.
Art style: {argument name="art_style" default="hand-painted 2D with clean silhouettes, in the spirit of modern painterly indie platformers"}.

# Traversal readability (most important)
- A clear main walkable route made of flat, brightly edged platforms and ledges that obviously support the player; walkable tops have a consistent highlight rim.
- One visible gated path that clearly needs a later ability: {argument name="gated_ability" default="a high ledge reachable only with a double jump, with a glowing collectible on it"}.
- One hazard zone (for example spikes or toxic water) with a distinct warning colour.
- A small player character silhouette at true scale on the main route so the size of the space is obvious.

# Depth layers
- Foreground: dark, out-of-focus silhouettes (pillars, hanging roots) framing the edges, never covering the route.
- Playfield: highest contrast and saturation in the image.
- Midground and background: progressively lighter and lower in contrast with atmospheric haze, built as separate parallax layers.
- Focal landmark in the background: {argument name="landmark" default="a giant cracked rose window glowing from behind"}, which guides the eye along the route.

# Lighting and palette
- Main light from the landmark, secondary glow from the fungus, cool ambient fill.
- Palette: {argument name="palette" default="deep violet and teal shadows, cyan fungus glow, a single warm gold accent on collectibles and doors"}.

# Avoid
Ambiguous surfaces that could be wall or floor, background detail with the same contrast as the playfield, perspective views, UI, text, watermarks, existing franchise characters or iconography.
